description: Beneath a pink stucco ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the honey gold oak walls.  A large brass-bound chest and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a bathing maiden statue rests on a honey gold oak floor.

Enclosed by glossy onyx-inset walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its stone floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a gold-veined black marble counter.
